verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer includes a full cloud browser that launches automatically when a task requires interacting with a website, filling forms, or accessing login-gated content. It also searches and browses for real-time research and can be used via MCP. A hands-on community report says Computer often fails to trigger from the UI and sessions frequently stall, but it does not deny the browsing capability, so this lowers quality and confidence rather than making the claim disputed. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of reliable end-to-end task completion, detailed docs on browser-agent controls and supervision (e.g., user takeover or confirmation steps), and clear documentation of browser control in the consumer app beyond the MCP integration.
